description: this is a very specific mod that aims to hyper optimise lunar client 26.2 just for a bit of fun. the research and and profiling was done by yours truly, and then fed into claude to implement.

mods.name: Lunar Frame Squeezer
mods.description: Removes redundant per-frame work from the Minecraft render thread on Lunar Client. Every optimisation is behind a config flag and every flag defaults to off.
